name: Capital Bikeshare Daily Trips
citation: Fanaee-T, Hadi, and Joao Gama. "Event Labeling Combining Ensemble Detectors and Background Knowledge." Progress in Artificial Intelligence, vol. 2, Springer, 2013, pp. 113-127.
license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0), UCI Machine Learning Repository.
description:
Daily total rental-bike trip counts for the Capital Bikeshare system (Washington, DC), 2011-01-01 to 2012-12-31, with the UCI-bundled normalized weather covariates. Target = realized daily trips. Application: fleet rebalancing and demand planning.

Covariate glossary:
- bike trips: total system-wide rental-bike trips per day on Capital Bikeshare, Washington DC (target).
- temp: air temperature normalized to [0,1] as t/41 in Celsius (UCI convention).
- atemp: apparent 'feels-like' temperature normalized to [0,1] as t/50 in Celsius.
- hum: relative humidity normalized to [0,1] (raw percent / 100).
- windspeed: wind speed normalized to [0,1] (raw / 67).
- weathersit: weather situation category 1 to 4 (1 clear, 2 mist/cloudy, 3 light rain/snow, 4 heavy rain/snow/fog).
preprocessing: 1. Loaded UCI Bike Sharing day.csv (731 daily rows).
2. Target = cnt (total daily rentals), renamed bike trips.
3. Dropped casual & registered (they sum exactly to the target -> composing-partition leakage).
4. Removed all calendar-derived features (day-of-week Fourier, working-day, holiday) so only the single shared time index encodes calendar position; kept genuine external weather covariates.
